name: Pi coding agent (pi -p --mode json)
role: opt-in executor. Not selected unless --backend pi is passed, or "pi" is listed in routing.default_order
binary_resolution: OPENSWARM_PI_BIN (may be a wrapper that takes the same flags and prints Pi json events), else pi on PATH, else ~/.local/bin/pi
model: --model, else policy pi.default_model, else Pi's configured default
quota_source: none (unknown). Token usage is summed from assistant message_end events after the run, not used for routing
streaming_events: json lines; assistant message_end events carry usage and text
dataBoundary: worktree + the provider Pi is configured for
